why: Backtest harness and tests only, in response to the manager's independent review of #14583: scripts/backtest_trend.py gains bar_label (open|close; main() passes close only with --resample) so a resampled, close-stamped bar is no longer flattened a whole bar early, and converts a tz-aware timestamp column to UTC before taking the day; tests/test_trend_dayflat.py replaces a byte-identity test that skipped forever with a comparison against a stored pre-lever baseline (tests/fixtures/trend_pre_dayflat_baseline.json, generated from the harness at 2058a2f1) and adds resample, main() and non-UTC tests. Default path unchanged. RQ-20260930-503 (blocked/) states it uses native candles. No execute.py, config or strategy parameter.
